scope: Actual AI ticks and swept hostile projectiles; shooter motion disabled and player placed/flying to isolate 100m boundaries, angles, timing and collision; expanded ground/roof patrols are verified separately
passed_cases: Ready state rejects fire; player starts with one life; safe ground patrol radius extends beyond the old 4m limit
Start normal AI ticks with player just outside the 100m range
No fire at 100.01m; patrol speed is doubled to 3.2m/s; enter exactly 100m
Real AI emits exactly three straight shots at -30/0/+30 degrees at 100m; immediate re-fire rejected
Second AI volley occurs two seconds later; pause with live projectiles
Pause freezes firing and projectiles; leave firing range after resume
Leaving range stops volleys; fire through a teammate toward a thin world wall
Hostile shot passes a red teammate without friendly damage or obstruction
15cm wall stops a travelling shot; muzzle sweep also prevents spawning through a close wall
Actual swept hostile projectile causes one-hit loss and one large explosion; late damage rejected
Round end removes both factions' projectiles
Retry restores all enemies, one life, 100m range, two-second interval and fresh firing state
